description: Start the 36-, 60-, or 240-question political test, or resume with a saved resume_token. Ask one statement at a time. Record chosen answers with axes_record_answers and keep its latest token. quiz_id and next_offset still support stateless pagination.

language.description: Question language, default en. The quiz_id selects the language for later pages.

quiz_id.description: The exact quiz_id returned by axes_get_questions. Identifies the selected statements; does not store answers. Use the latest resume_token to preserve progress.

resume_token.description: Latest resume_token. It contains the recorded choices: keep it in the client, not in public links.

variant.description: short has 36 questions, extended has 60, extreme has 240. The default is short.
